cohortPolicy: Security-level origin population, stable securityId, not current tickers or current CIK deduplication. A partial snapshot cannot replace a complete baseline.
coveragePolicy: Complete baseline AND complete domain coverage evidence required. Partial public notices are seed evidence only; no minimum observed row count implies completeness.
immutability: Raw source bytes, normalized input, origin request list, protocol and preserved prior-file hashes are frozen. Different inputs require a new bundle/version.
lifecyclePolicy: Retain frozen cohorts through target date regardless of membership or alias changes. Left join all outcomes; report missing/pending/unresolved rows. Incomplete cohorts cannot report numeric aggregate metrics.
limitations: Public dated notices retrieved in 2026 do not certify their historical page revision vintage.
Local notice security IDs demonstrate lineage but are not permanent vendor identities; identity events remain absent.
No full historical baseline, sector/alias history, delisted price series or final return coverage is available in this source branch.
This builds a boundary and exposes the data blocker; it neither resolves all survivorship bias nor produces a new model result.

Session-open convention uses America/New_York DST; explicit origin dates are supplied, not generated by an exchange calendar. Lookback length and freshness must be specified by a future feature protocol.
originConvention: Input knownAt < origin session open; membership/sector/identity effectiveAt <= origin session open. Price sessionDate < origin date. All timestamps explicit timezone.

references.role: provider contract candidate; not downloaded or certified
historical sector export candidate; no assumed original-availability column

requiredHistoricalInputs: Complete dated SP500 security-level baseline(s) for legacy origins 2009-11-13 through 2025-10-31; no backward reconstruction from current survivors.
Complete membership change/correction ledger with original knownAt and effectiveAt; evidence of no unreported additions/removals.
Historical GICS classifications with their own availability/effective dates and taxonomy versions; no current-sector forward/backward fill.
Permanent security and issuer/share-class identifiers, dated aliases including renamed, removed, merged and delisted securities.
Original-availability daily price vintages for every cohort member; revised current adjusted prices cannot certify past features.
Full-horizon security-level returns with distributions, mergers, delisting settlement and contingent rights; retain unresolved or missing outcome rows.
sourceClock: Historical original publication/provider timestamp evidence required independently of retrieval. Date-only US notices usable from next New York midnight. Later corrections apply only after their own knownAt.
terminalPolicy: Do not substitute zero return, last price, acquiring security, or guaranteed cash for unresolved delisting wealth. True zero terminal wealth is retained; price/log-ratio metrics undefined.
